network: Cannot reach the server. Is it running?
internal: Something went wrong on the server.
host.forbidden: The request was blocked for security reasons.
conflict.version: Someone else changed this first; reload and try again.
book.invalid_state: The book is not in a state that allows this.
chapter.invalid_state: The chapter is not in a state that allows this.
chapter.session_exists: An agent session is open on this chapter.
chapter.previous_not_ready: The previous chapter is not ready yet.
chapter.is_anchor: This chapter anchors a side story.
chapter.locked: The writer is working — pause it to edit.
settings.locked: The conception agent is working on this book.
proposal.invalid_state: This proposal can no longer be changed.
model.missing_role: No model is configured for this role.
conception.incomplete: The conception is not finished yet.
track.mode_locked: The canon mode cannot change any more.
session.invalid_state: The session is not in a state that allows this.
search.not_configured: No web search provider is configured.
embedding.unavailable: The embedding model is not available.
provider.auth: The provider rejected the API key.
research.invalid_state: The research task is not in a state that allows this.
conception.unavailable: No conception model is configured, so the book was created without it.
context.large_kickoff: This chapter's context is more than half the model's window; the agent may run out of room. Shorten the outline or split the chapter.
provider.context_overflow: This conversation grew past the model's context window. The history is kept — continue in a new session or from a shorter point.
provider.refusal: The model declined this request. Change the instruction rather than sending the same one again.
agent.tool_error_streak: The agent failed to use its tools several times in a row and the session paused. Clear up the instruction, then continue.
agent.no_tool_call: The agent replied with text where a tool call was required, so the session paused. Continue with a clearer instruction.
model.missing_provider: The model's provider was deleted. Choose another model in Settings › Agent roles, then continue.
prompt.override_failed: A prompt override could not be used and the default was used instead.
chapter.outline_missing: This chapter has no outline yet. Write the outline first.
goal.open_children: This goal still has open descendants.
goal.has_children: This goal has children; move or delete them first.
